description: SimpleBeacon local LLM model registry — maps model IDs to their Modelfile, context window, and optimized parameters. Version 2 adds quantization and memory budget metadata for air-gapped deployment planning.
quantization: Q4_K_M (4.84 bits/weight) — recommended balance for production. ~4.4 GB VRAM for 7B models, minimal quality loss vs FP16.

unbreakable-oracle.description: SimpleBeacon's default code analysis model — based on llama3.2 3B with optimized system prompt for security and compliance analysis. Smallest model — fastest inference, lowest memory.

simplebeacon-llama32.description: Llama 3.2 3B with SimpleBeacon's code analysis system prompt. Smallest context window — best for resource-constrained machines.

simplebeacon-mistral.description: Mistral 7B with SimpleBeacon's code analysis system prompt. 32K context window allows more files per batch in multi-file sweeps. Requires 16GB+ RAM.

simplebeacon-qwen-coder.description: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B — specifically tuned for code analysis. 32K context window with code-optimized tokenization. Requires 16GB+ RAM.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Model ID to use for inference

OLLAMA_NUM_CTX.description: Override context window size (tokens). If set, takes precedence over Modelfile PARAMETER num_ctx.

PROCESSOR_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum file size (MB) for the automated processor

SIMPLEBEACON_OFFLINE.description: Force offline mode (local Ollama only, no cloud providers)
